alternatives.name: Awesome MCP servers registry
alternatives.why_not_default: The retained decision identifies this registry as unexamined. No specific entry has demonstrated bridge, inspection or configuration acceptance; registry inclusion alone supplies no operational evidence.

limits: Reviewed retained evidence only; no new native execution or current-host qualification was performed.
Inspector's private raw operation captures were not available in the reviewed public receipt; its recorded checks were inspected.
Upstream release metadata was taken from the packet and was not independently refreshed.
open_gaps: Inspector's arithmetic execution does not establish complete client plugin behavior, hooks, project-file scope or current Desktop connectivity.
mcporter recovery required intervention after stale metadata refusal and a startup timeout; automatic recovery was not established.
Shared-daemon isolation, persistence, scoped registration cleanup and changed-process-root recovery lack complete lifecycle acceptance.
Project configuration policy is documented source evidence; it does not certify every server or client configuration.
No executed comparison establishes superiority over a reviewed registry candidate or qualifies mcporter v0.14.0 against retained v0.13.13 behavior.

arms: Retained mcporter 0.13.13 bridge plus MCP Inspector 2.7.0 direct inspection
A specifically reviewed challenger providing the same scoped bridge, inspection and configuration operations
overturn_protocol.metric: Execute the same source-grounded symbol request against fixtures/before.py and verify greeting is returned; compare discovery and call correctness, project-root isolation, restart recovery and scoped cleanup. Apply the lifecycle boundaries recorded in the saturation audit and retain failures and actual outputs.

overturn_when: Change the verdict when an executed comparison using fixtures/before.py returns the expected greeting symbol through both arms and demonstrates that a reviewed challenger preserves inspection and configuration correctness while resolving the incumbent recovery or isolation gaps recorded in blueprints/token-native-focus/saturation-audit.json. Catalog agreement or static receipt validation alone is insufficient.
why_selected: Select c3 and c1 for complementary, bounded native operations. observability/restart-receipt.json records mcporter 0.13.13 starting after guarded stale-metadata recovery, discovering 11 tools and returning bridge-recovered from native execution. evidence/receipts/token-native-retained-functional-20260920.json records MCP Inspector invoking Context Mode over stdio, exiting successfully and passing the 42-computed check. These are retained native executions, with Inspector limited to an arithmetic fixture. recipes/README.md supplies source-reviewed project configuration procedures and distinguishes tool discovery from functional calls. Together they cover the demonstrated bridge and inspection needs under the project policy without promoting an unexamined registry entry.
